grace_et_al.source: Grace et al., Thousands of AI Authors on the Future of AI, arXiv:2401.02843v2 (PDF read first-hand 2026-10-07)
grace_et_al.abstract: Between 37.8% and 51.4% of respondents gave at least a 10% chance to advanced AI leading to outcomes as bad as human extinction.
grace_et_al.sec4.3: Depending on how we asked, between 41.2% and 51.4% of respondents estimated a greater than 10% chance of human extinction or severe disempowerment (see Figure 13).
grace_et_al.footnote4: Any individual respondent did not see more than one of these questions.
grace_et_al.fig12_caption: Question 1 n=149 in 2022 and 1321 in 2023. Question 2 n=162 in 2022 and 661 in 2023. Question 3 was asked only in 2023, n=655
grace_et_al.sec6.4: Out of the 20,066 emails we contacted, 1,607 (8%) bounced or failed, leaving 18,459 functioning email addresses. We received 2,778 responses
